During the [[Desolator crisis|crisis]] involving the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] and stolen [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred in the [[Shock Drum facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After the facility's defenses were destroyed in a [[Attack on the Shock Drum facility|previous attack]], the native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] attacked the compound until a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] arrived and drove them off.
